assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Precursor ions were chosen based on intensity thresholds (>1e3) from the full scan as well as on charge states (2-7) with a 30-s dynamic exclusion window.
The MS2 spectra were collected using a 1.6 m/z isolation width and were analyzed either by the Orbitrap or the linear ion trap depending on peak charge and intensity using a 3s TopSpeed CHOPIN method
labeling: Label Free Quantification (LFQ) and match between runs were enabled.
quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using Flag-tagged CDR1. Acquisition is DDA (TopSpeed CHOPIN method with dynamic exclusion). Quantification is LFQ.

scope: we identified protein interacting partners of CDR1 using epitope-mediated immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry (IP-MS)
The IP was performed overnight (16-18hr) at 4oC with 10mg (HEK293T) or 25mg (SKMES1-LN1) of protein by rotating gently with the washed FLAG beads.
Samples were washed four times in 0.1% NP40 lysis buffer before being subjected to a modified FASP digestion and on bead trypsinization.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material affinity-purified via IP-MS using FLAG beads to capture CDR1-Flag and its interacting partners.
